releases.text: Added 7 marketing use cases (SEO & content, social scheduling, landing pages, newsletters, design & video, community, web analytics) and 18 tools; solo and pre-seed to Series A stacks now include a marketing section.
Directory launched (draft) with 23 tools across 8 use cases. Weekly release and price-change log coming.

solo.assumptions: 1 person, 1 LinkedIn account, ~5,000 emails/mo, monthly billing, entry tiers. Marketing: free tiers used where they exist; Carrd priced yearly ÷ 12.
items: Lowest published entry price for outbound email in our list.
Free plan covers email finding/verification at solo volume.
Free credits for finding target companies; Hunter then finds the emails.
Cheapest listed LinkedIn tool (per user, EUR).
Free website-visitor identification; a different signal from product analytics.
Free first-party search data: which queries bring visitors. Ahrefs Free is a good second look but would overlap.
Cheapest custom-domain landing page in our list; $19/yr is the yearly price on its Pro page.
Free forever plan; upgrade to Lite ($49/mo yearly) only when monetizing.
Free video editing for short clips; Canva (price not verified) is an optional design add-on and is not counted.

growth.assumptions: 3 people, 2 LinkedIn senders, ~5,000 emails/mo, monthly billing. Marketing: Surfer and Framer at their lowest listed paid tiers (yearly-billing view); Canva and Discord optional and not counted.
items: Top value score for outbound; unlimited mailboxes on one plan. Its lead credits are not added because Hunter covers enrichment.
Finding and verifying emails, so no second data plan is needed.
Per-sender pricing scales with 2 founders/SDRs on LinkedIn.
Identifies site visitors to feed outbound.
Product analytics on the free allowance.
Optional; only if you want an AI SDR instead of hiring one.
Social scheduling for a small team.
Video creation (a separate job from scheduling): demos and outbound videos.
Free first-party search data; tracks whether content ranks.
Content optimization is a separate job from tracking; Discovery is its lowest listed tier.
Design-led pages with custom domain; Basic is its lowest paid tier. Monthly-billing price not verified.
Free until you monetize; Lite is $49/mo yearly billing.
Common design pick, but its pricing page blocked our fetch, so it is not counted. HeyGen already covers video.
Free-to-start community option, but no vendor price was captured, so it is not counted.

later.assumptions: 10+ people, 10 LinkedIn senders, high email volume, monthly list prices except Common Room (billed annually).
items: Higher-volume outbound tier on the same tool.
Scale tier for team-wide email finding and verification.
One sender per rep on LinkedIn.
Social scheduling across a marketing team.
Intent and community signals across channels; replaces RB2B at this stage.
Optional AI SDR; price on request.
